intent: Define the first algebraic rules for NavT (Transport), including composition along chains, identity transport, and residual thresholding.

rules.condition: composition of transport operators along an admissible chain
transport to self is the identity transform

rule.name: transport_residual_rule_v1
rule.statement: The transport residual delta_T = (NavT(a,b) ∘ NavT(b,c)) - NavT(a,c) must remain below a declared threshold tau_T for the chain to be considered consistent.

rules.name: no_associative_transport_without_residual_check_v1
rules.statement: Transport composition must not be assumed associative (NavT(a,b) ∘ NavT(b,c) = NavT(a,c)) unless the residual delta_T is proven to be zero.

rules.name: no_identity_transport_drift_v1
rules.statement: NavT(a,a) must evaluate to identity; any nonzero result indicates illegal reference or phase drift.

missing_definitions: formal composition law for non-local indices
explicit threshold tau_T per mechanism class
